Who runs clinical trials in Europe?

Find small trial sponsors (biotechs, research centres, hospitals with 10 trials or fewer in CTIS) that run clinical trials without enterprise tools. The default view shows every sponsor; use the segments or the filters to focus on small sponsors or on France. The figures below follow the filters.

Source: CTIS register (EU Clinical Trials Information System), extracted on 4 November 2026: 10,000 trials, sponsors after merging duplicates (spelling variants and subsidiaries of the same pharma group; MSD and Merck KGaA are kept separate).
Filters apply to trials: each sponsor is ranked on its matching trials only. The fit score (0-100) favours small sponsors, trials that are starting, new sponsors, multi-country or early-phase work and a presence in France; open a sponsor to see how its score is built. Sponsor headquarters, third parties and contacts come from the public CTIS API, for target sponsors only. It is a prioritisation heuristic, not an official ranking.
